reuse.why: Adds one guard to the existing accounts/link.ts module, using db.first in the same style as findOrCreateBank, and calls it from every provider's link function.

duplication.why: The rule is a single query; the five provider functions only add a one-line call with their provider name.

placement.why: The guard sits in link.ts next to findOrCreateBank, which already holds the shared linking logic for the provider handlers in app.ts.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Clear and small; the call must still be repeated in each of five copied link functions (a pre-existing structure), so a new provider could forget it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All link handlers go through link.assertAccountIsNotLinked.

one_place.where: assertAccountIsNotLinked in server/accounts/link.ts, called by linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount.
